info:
This song, piano-follows-guitar-basic-blues.json, has a Piano (called Piano_listener) "Listening" (following) a Standard-tuning guitar (called S6_lead).


"Listening" means that notes saved in S6_lead's track are wired to play through Piano_listener's track. So you can see Piano_listenerer "following" every note S6_lead plays. The notes were chosen to be playable on both guitar and piano.


You can add more notes to S6_lead by chosing a note style from the palette (Named, Single, Tiny, Bend) and then clicking in a cell or string before the fret, and these will automatically appear on the Piano. You may have to scroll the piano left and right to be in the same pitch range on both instrument. You can hover around until you see a scrollbar, or you can do a two-finger trackpad scroll. To know which pitches are identical, use View | Show MIDI Number. To get the MIDI Number to stick around as you navigate away from this Section, click SAVE Display Options before you leave the View menu.


To get the instruments to fit in your browser, use your browser's CTRL + and CTRL - keyboard shortcuts.


To see a song where the Guitar listens to the Piano, open "guitar-follows-piano-basic-blues.json".


Take a look at the Chart: Chart | Chart. This lets you click on a Section and navigate to it.


You can also toggle the "Transport" on an off with keyboard shortcut "t", and you can loop from there, or toggle looping with keyboard shortcut "l" ( l for loop).
